mapper.insert: insert into reviews (project_id, route_id, from_account_id, to_account_id, review_type, overall_score, content) values (#{projectId}, #{routeId}, #{fromAccountId}, #{toAccountId}, #{reviewType}, #{overallScore}, #{content})
mapper.update: update reviews set project_id = #{projectId}, route_id = #{routeId}, from_account_id = #{fromAccountId}, to_account_id = #{toAccountId}, review_type = #{reviewType}, overall_score = #{overallScore}, content = #{content} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, project_id, route_id, from_account_id, to_account_id, review_type, overall_score, content, created_at from reviews
select avg(overall_score) from reviews where to_account_id = #{toAccountId} and review_type = 'USER_TO_LEADER'
select count(*) from reviews where to_account_id = #{toAccountId} and review_type = 'USER_TO_LEADER'
mapper.sql: r.id, r.project_id, r.route_id, r.from_account_id as reviewer_account_id, reviewer.username as reviewer_name, reviewer.avatar_url as reviewer_avatar_url, r.overall_score, r.content, r.created_at
mapper.select: select from reviews r inner join accounts reviewer on reviewer.id = r.from_account_id where r.to_account_id = #{toAccountId} and r.review_type = 'USER_TO_LEADER' order by r.created_at desc, r.id desc

select from reviews r inner join accounts reviewer on reviewer.id = r.from_account_id where r.to_account_id = #{toAccountId} and r.review_type = 'USER_TO_LEADER' order by r.created_at desc, r.id desc limit #{limit}
